description: Simulation record schema for the archive. ARCHIVE NOTE (2026-10-03): no simulations exist for any seeded design — every seeded record carries sim_status NOT_SIMULATED. This schema defines the required fields for a record to be honestly labeled SIMULATED; a design may never be marked SIMULATED without all of these on file.
